items.title: Strong Results from CoreWeave, Super Micro Computer Boost Stock Futures
items.summary: Stocks tied to the AI trade are back on top this morning after stellar results from CoreWeave and Super Micro Computer.  Cloud-computing company CoreWeave reported its fifth consecutive quarter of record revenue and a sales backlog of $104 billion yesterday—in the latest sign of continued strength of demand for AI computing.  Server company Super Micro Computer reported sales that nearly doubled in its fiscal fourth quarter and surging profit.

items.title: Why Is Marvell Technology (MRVL) Investing $250 Million In India Now?
items.summary: Marvell Technology (NasdaqGS:MRVL) announced a planned US$250 million investment in India aimed at expanding its presence in the country. The company intends to roughly double its local headcount and grow facilities to support work on semiconductors, AI and cloud related solutions. Marvell plans to deepen its role in India's semiconductor ecosystem through R&D, university collaboration and industry partnerships. The move signals a long term commitment to building global engineering capacity...

items.title: What Is The Market Really Expecting From AVGO Stock?
items.summary: At $422, Broadcom (AVGO) is being priced to deliver 26% revenue growth annually for the next 5 years simply to defend today's 68.4x multiple. That sits below the 32% the business is currently growing at, which is the unusual part. The multiple has already priced in a slowdown that has not yet appeared.

items.title: The Options Market Says Marvell Stock Could Halve Or More Than Double
items.summary: This band is not a panic premium; it sits close to what the stock has actually delivered over the past year, and a holder carries every bit of that width.
